data.text:
Welcoming a pet into your home is an exceptional experience, but it also comes with its own set of challenges. Whether you're a long-time resident or new to the city, this guide will provide you with essential tips and practical advice on making your house pet-friendly in Dubai, ensuring a happy and healthy living environment for your beloved companions. From choosing the right materials and pet-proofing your space to finding local pet services and adhering to Dubai's pet regulations, we've got you covered. Let's explore how to transform your home into a pet paradise in the heart of the UAE.

Effective Ways to Make Your Home Pet-friendly

Have a Minimalistic Home

You must have an open yet cosy space where your pet can roam and play freely. A minimalist design helps with just that. It is one of the most effective ways to make your home pet-friendly. A minimalist home is much easier to keep clean with fewer items and less clutter. This is particularly beneficial for pet owners, as it simplifies managing pet hair, dander, and the occasional mess.

Choose a Pet-Friendly Area in Dubai

If you are bringing a furry friend to the emirate, choose a pet-friendly area in Dubai. These communities offer plenty of opportunities for pets to enjoy outdoor activities and exercise. The areas boast several pet services, including veterinary clinics, pet grooming salons, and pet supply stores, making it convenient for pet owners to take care of their pets' needs.

Avoid Placing Carpets and Rugs

While these items greatly impact the home décor, they do not make a good choice if you intend to keep pets. The reason? Most pets, particularly bunnies, cats, and dogs, shed. Also, most carpets and rugs are not that easy to clean. They can easily accumulate bacteria and dust, which not only poses health risks for your furry friends but for yourself and your family as well.

If it’s absolutely necessary to have rugs and/or carpets, opt for a fabric that can be cleaned easily. The same piece of advice should be followed for upholstery. Furthermore, you can pick scratch-free materials for it as well. Also, the colours of upholstery must be selected carefully. Avoid light colours as they are more prone to getting dirty. Choosing quality material can prove to be cost-effective as it lasts longer.

data.text:
Install Screens on Your Windows

Screens provide a crucial barrier that prevents pets from accidentally falling out of windows, especially in multi-story homes or apartments.

Pets, especially cats and small dogs, are known for their adventurous spirits. Screens act as a deterrent, preventing pets from squeezing through open windows and making unplanned outdoor excursions. This added security gives pet owners peace of mind, knowing their pets are safe inside.

Get Trash Cans with Lids

It’s not uncommon for pets to linger around in the kitchen area and explore their favourite part – the junk placed in the trash cans. This, however, can be quite dangerous for them since the trash can often contains pieces of indigestible items, harmful chemicals, and other such things.

You can’t restrict their access to the trash can, however, getting trash cans with lids can prove to be useful. Since the junk remains covered, your pet won’t be able to reach it.

Get Blockades

Pets are adventurous and curious beings who particularly like to inspect areas they are not supposed to. This, however, can get them in trouble.

Installing blockades in order to restrict their entry to these places, such as the laundry area, is one practical option to make your home pet-friendly. You can get different types of blockades in a range of designs and colours. Choose the ones that go with the overall theme of your home for the aesthetic effect.

Carefully Place Fragile Items

Pets aren’t very careful around things. Cats, in particular, love climbing up the cabinets. So, if you want to protect your precious belongings and fragile items, place them carefully where they cannot be accessed by pets.

Have Dedicated Feeding & Litter Areas

If you want to create a pet-friendly place, it is recommended to have separate areas dedicated for these purposes. The feeding place should be in plain sight and easily accessible for pets. Still, it shouldn’t impact your home décor. The area underneath the cabinet is the best choice for this purpose.

On the contrary, the litter area must be away from plain sight. If you have a guest bathroom in your home, you can use it to place the litter box. Or, the laundry area can be selected for this purpose as well.

There you have it! By following these tips, you can make your home pet-friendly and create a safe space for your pets.
